Choose how you want to work with your product, then select your operation mode.

PRE-RELEASE · INTERNAL USE ONLY
v0.1 · VEU AI Studio personnel + licensed pilots

FlowAI is a universal product upgrade engine. Give it a product URL, description, or supporting context and it runs the 8-step pipeline — Research, Design, Build, Quality Audit, Deploy, Self-Renewal, Go-to-Market, Monitor — toward the CEO-defined 95/100 target.

What you get: a per-step report, honest scoring evidence, and an upgraded URL when deployment succeeds. Display bands: Excellent 90–100 · Strong 75–89 · Developing 50–74 · Needs Work 25–49 · Critical 0–24. Human-only criteria remain unverified until evidence exists; FlowAI reports gaps instead of inflating the score.

SETUP 1 OF 3 — SELECT YOUR INPUT(one of three setup steps; the 8-step pipeline runs after launch)

Analyze a Live Product

FlowAI will fetch and analyze the public-facing pages of your product.

Test Fetch

Note: URL must be publicly accessible. Authenticated or private apps use Card B or C.

Describe Your Product

Type or speak a description. Best for authenticated apps, internal tools, or early-stage products.

🔒 Credentials are used only for this session and are never stored.

Voice Input

Paste Content or Upload Screenshots

Paste page text, copy, or upload screenshots. FlowAI analyzes what you give it directly.

Drop screenshots here or click to upload — PNG, JPG, PDF

Combine with Card B for best results on authenticated products.

SETUP 2 OF 3 — WHAT DO YOU WANT TO ACCOMPLISH?

Audit for prospect demo readiness
Prepare for investor review
Full governance and clearance cycle
Compare two or more products
Combine inputs into a unified specification
Benchmark against competitors
Launch readiness check
Custom — I will describe my objective

SETUP 3 OF 3 — SELECT OPERATION MODE

Auto
SELECTED

FlowAI executes all 8 pipeline steps automatically — Research → Design → Build → Quality Audit → Deploy → Self-Renewal → Go-to-Market → Monitor. You review the final report with the Clearance score and per-step findings.

Analysis Depth

Quick
Standard
Deep
Guided

FlowAI proposes each of the 8 pipeline steps in turn. You approve, modify, or skip each one before it executes.

Minutes to hours · 8 approval gates across the execution pipeline

Manual

You direct each step. FlowAI executes what you specify and assists on demand.

Hours to days · Full operator control

Fresh Build
EXPERIMENTAL

FlowAI runs Feature Extractor, Design Synthesizer, and Codebase Generator to create a platform-free codebase in the upgrade repo.

Fresh Build is enabled for this environment. Existing modes remain unchanged.
Migrate

FlowAI detects platform dependencies and migrates the product to a standalone v2. Original stays frozen as rollback.

Plan

File count and dependency count before execution

Progress

Per-file migration status during execution

Summary

Files migrated, dependencies removed, upgrade URL
